stations.title: Kwame
stations.say: My Book buttons are still grey.
stations.note: He made them orange in January.

stations.title: Film card
stations.text: Book and Trailer, two grey buttons.
stations.note: Nobody can tell which one books.

stations.title: Film card
stations.note: On a phone and on a wide screen.

captions: At the Wrenfield, Kwame finds the Book buttons still grey after he made them orange.
On every film card, Book and Trailer look the same, so nobody can tell them apart.
You find the rule that wins over Kwame's and fix it, then check what sits beside it.
Now the Book buttons stand out, and the Trailer links look as they did.
Same page, same rules. The one meant for the buttons is the one that wins.
